content:
liam_sales: Heads-up: BigRetail wants a PoC in their walled-garden DC. No internet, transfers via USB or internal artifact mirror only. They asked about licensing, pricing uplift for airgap support, and how we prove the artifact chain.

sara_se: Clarify: are they asking for an on-demand one-off build signed for them, or will they pull from our standard on-prem release artifacts mirrored internally?

liam_sales: Prefer one-off signed bundle for the POC. They want the bundle signed, SBOM, and a documented verification flow for auditors. Also asked whether offline license activation adds extra cost.

nate_ops: Tech feasibility: we can produce a self-contained bundle (tar.gz) with all binaries, db schema, and a minimal container runtime shim if needed. Options: full-image bundle (largest), delta patch bundles (smaller, more work), or OCI archive to push to their internal registry. For PoC, recommend full-image bundle to reduce variables.

hannah_sec: Security requirements we need to cover: reproducible SBOM, signed release artifacts, detached GPG/PKCS#7 signatures, time-stamped provenance, offline cert rotation guidance, and proof of signature verification without network. They also want a simple verification command for auditors.

sara_se: Example verification snippet we can provide in docs: 
```
# verify checksum and signature locally
sha256sum redwood-poc-2026-04-08.tar.gz > redwood.sha256
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature redwood-poc.tar.sig redwood.sha256
```
We should also include the PEM we used to sign and a signed manifest.json with component checksums.

liam_sales: Pricing question: customer expects base on-prem price + one-time "airgap packaging" fee if we need to do custom per-customer signing/builds and manual QA. Can we estimate?

nate_ops: Ballpark: for a single PoC bundle and docs + 2 QA cycles, we should ask for $Xk one-time engineering fee. For recurring customers requiring quarterly signed builds and delta patches, add a per-quarter ops fee or include in an enterprise support tier. I'll put numbers in the SOW draft.

hannah_sec: Also we must add contractual language that we will not ship telemetry/phone-home code and that `telemetry.enabled=false` is enforced at build-time. Also include an attestable build env (hash of build container) in provenance.

sara_se: On license activation: we can support an offline enterprise license file. We generate a signed license blob (JSON+signature) that the customer drops into /etc/redwood/license.json and runs `redwoodctl license install --file /etc/redwood/license.json`. No outbound required. Example: 
```
# install license
sudo cp license-BigRetail.json /etc/redwood/license.json
sudo redwoodctl license install --file /etc/redwood/license.json
redwoodctl status | grep License
```
We should document expiry, revocation, and rotation procedures.

liam_sales: They asked about upgrade cadence and emergency patches. Their security ops only allow quarterly maintenance windows. They want emergency security fixes allowed but with explicit SOW clause and signed delta patch.

nate_ops: Plan: quarterly major releases + critical security patch track. For critical patches we'll ship signed deltas and a rollback command. Implementation detail: keep previous release under /opt/redwood/releases/<ts> and provide `redwoodctl apply --patch patch.tar.gz` and `redwoodctl rollback --to <ts>`. We'll include verification steps for the patch before commit.

hannah_sec: Need to support offline verification of delta patches too. Signed manifest must list pre-state and post-state checksums so they can confirm integrity. Also record in the SBOM which components changed.

sara_se: Acceptance criteria we will propose for PoC:
- Install succeeds from provided USB bundle without external network
- redwoodctl start && redwoodctl health shows all services UP
- Can perform a simple generate request (local test client) and retrieve metrics
- Auditor verification: SBOM present, signature verification steps pass, and license installs offline

liam_sales: Customer wants legal and procurement to sign a custom SOW that includes one-off packaging fee, liability for media transport, and patch SLA. I'll attach a draft and ask legal to review.

hannah_sec: I'll prepare the security appendix to attach to SOW: signing algorithm (RSA-4096 / ECDSA), offline verification commands, build provenance, HSM PKCS#11 sample config for Yubico if they want HSM-wrapped keys, and an escrow process for signing keys if required.

nate_ops: Logistics: We need the customer's acceptance criteria and preferred install window. Also ask if they will provide on-site hardware or want us to supply a prebuilt VM image.

deploy_bot: ticket ENG-POC-5902 created: "BigRetail walled-garden PoC - signed bundle + license & SOW" assigned to nate_ops, sara_se. ETA 14 days.

liam_sales: I'll schedule a kickoff call and include acceptance criteria. Thanks team :pray:
